_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-80a. As applied there is no `conventions:` key, so AGENTS.md must win and the other three candidates must never be fetched. Asserted against the review-details row the resolver itself writes — `Loaded from \u0060AGENTS.md\u0060` — rather than the absence of the three losing markers. All three marker files are in the overlay, so they are in the diff, so a finding, the diagram or cited-code evidence can quote them at any time: the absence form was unsatisfiable by luck rather than by contract. The walk down the chain needs pushes between steps and stays manual.
